text: Great lets have some fun then i have this here /home/siah/testing/coastal-city-sketch which was a mock up for world generation to get a nice baseline to start from, lets rewrite this same idea into the editor to be able to generate real map data with and see how it turns out
resolution: Implemented the coastal-city sketch as a deterministic canonical map-document generator in the active editor. The flow builds validated terrain, water, semantic road and rail paths, vegetation, and floor-site data, bulk-installs it through the native map engine, saves a normal RMAP, and switches documents transactionally. Planner, document, native map, editor build, and Zig 0.16 gates are green; visual inspection and the 60-second frame-time check remain review gates.
